seo.title: Interior Design AMC: What It Covers and What It Costs
seo.description: Do you need an AMC after your interiors are done? What an interior annual maintenance contract covers, what it costs, and how it differs from a warranty.

title: Do You Need an AMC After Your Interior Design Project? What It Covers and What It Costs
author: Shivam Kumar

featuredImage.alt: Open modular kitchen drawer showing cabinet hardware and channels, the kind of fittings covered under an interior design AMC

excerpt: Much of what an AMC promises in year one is already covered by your warranty. See what an interior design annual maintenance contract actually covers, what it costs, and when it's worth paying for.
keyTakeaways: An AMC Is Paid Upkeep, Not Free Defect Cover — A warranty fixes defects at no charge; an AMC is a separate annual fee for scheduled maintenance and wear.
You Rarely Need One in Year One — On-site warranties (often around a year) and longer hardware warranties already cover most early issues.
Comprehensive vs Non-Comprehensive Matters — Non-comprehensive looks cheaper but bills spare parts separately, which can close the price gap fast.
Benchmark Against Component Costs — AC servicing runs ₹2,000–₹6,000 per unit a year and a home lift AMC ₹12,000–₹35,000+; compare any all-in quote against these.
It Becomes Useful from Year Two — Especially for large homes, rented-out flats, owners who travel, and homes with a lift or central AC.
Get a Written Scope Before Signing — Exact tasks, visit count, response time and extra charges, with nothing already covered by the warranty.
contentHtml:
An interior AMC is a yearly contract for scheduled upkeep and minor repairs after your project is handed over: hinge and channel adjustments, sealant and touch-ups, and checks on electrical and plumbing points. You rarely need one in year one, because the warranty covers defects. It becomes useful from year two, for large homes, rental flats and owners who live away. There is no standard price, so compare each AMC with the cost of servicing items separately.

The handover is done, the snag list is closed, and someone offers you an annual maintenance contract. It sounds sensible, but much of what an AMC promises in the first year is already covered by your warranty. This guide explains what an interior design AMC actually covers, what it costs, and when it is worth paying for.

Key facts at a glance

QuestionShort answer
What is an AMC?A fixed annual fee for scheduled maintenance visits and minor repairs
Comprehensive vs non-comprehensive?Comprehensive includes spare parts; non-comprehensive covers labour and visits only
Is it the same as a warranty?No. A warranty fixes defects free; an AMC pays for upkeep and wear
When is it worth it?Usually from year two, after on-site warranties (often 1 year) lapse
What does AC servicing cost under an AMC?About ₹2,000 to ₹6,000 per unit a year
What does a home lift AMC cost?About ₹12,000 to ₹35,000+ a year, depending on coverage

What is an interior design AMC?

An annual maintenance contract is an agreement in which a service provider maintains specified items in your home for a fixed yearly fee. For interiors, that usually means scheduled visits to check and adjust woodwork, hardware and fittings, plus a set number of minor repairs.

There are two kinds:

  • Comprehensive AMC: labour, visits and spare parts are included.
  • Non-comprehensive AMC: labour and visits are included; spares are billed separately.

A non-comprehensive AMC looks cheaper, but a few replaced hinges, channels or fittings can close the gap quickly. Always ask which kind you are being offered.

Warranty vs AMC: don't pay twice

WarrantyAMC
What it coversDefects in material or workmanshipRoutine upkeep, adjustment and wear
Cost to youIncluded in the projectA separate annual fee
Typical periodUp to 1 year on site work; several years on modular units and hardwareRenewed each year
Spare partsFree if defectiveOnly in a comprehensive AMC
Water damage, misuseUsually excludedUsually excluded

The overlap is greatest in year one. A shutter that sags because a hinge failed is a warranty claim. A shutter that needs re-aligning after a year of daily use is maintenance. Read your item-wise warranty before you sign any AMC, and buy cover only for what the warranty does not already handle.

What an interior AMC typically covers

AreaTypical AMC work
Modular kitchen and wardrobesHinge and channel adjustment, lubrication, handle tightening, minor edge-band fixes
CountertopsGranite resealing; re-sealing silicone around sinks and hobs
False ceiling and paintHairline crack filling and touch-ups
ElectricalChecks on switches, sockets and the distribution board; replacing failed fittings
PlumbingLeak checks at sinks, taps and traps; resealing joints
Doors and windowsAlignment, closers, locks and stoppers
Air-conditioningScheduled servicing, often through a separate AC AMC

What an AMC usually does not cover

  • New work, redesign or replacement of whole units.
  • Damage from seepage, flooding or structural movement.
  • Misuse, accidents and pest damage.
  • Appliances such as chimneys, hobs and ovens, which normally come under the brand's own warranty or service plan.
  • Spare parts, in a non-comprehensive contract.
  • Deep cleaning and polishing, unless named in the contract.

What does an interior AMC cost?

There is no published standard price for an interior AMC. Providers price by home size, number of visits and whether spares are included. The most useful way to judge a quote is against the cost of the parts you would otherwise service separately:

ComponentTypical annual costNotes
Air-conditioning₹2,000 to ₹6,000 per unitDepends on servicing frequency and whether parts are included
Home lift₹12,000 to ₹18,000 (basic) up to ₹25,000 to ₹35,000+ (comprehensive)Relevant for villas and multi-level homes
Woodwork, hardware, minor civil, electrical and plumbingQuoted per homeAsk for the number of visits and a list of tasks included

As an example, a home with four split ACs would spend about ₹8,000 to ₹24,000 a year on AC servicing alone at those rates. If an all-in AMC costs little more than that and includes the carpentry, electrical and plumbing visits, it is good value. If it costs much more, you are paying for convenience.

Ask whether the quote includes GST, and whether visit charges apply for calls outside the scheduled visits.

Do you actually need one?

You probably need an AMC ifYou can probably skip it if
Your on-site warranty has endedYou are still in the first year after handover
You own a large home or villa with many systemsYour home is compact and you can book help as needed
The flat is rented outYou live in the home and notice issues early
You live abroad or travel oftenYour interior firm already offers free post-handover support
You have a lift, automation or central ACYour appliances are under brand service plans

Eight things to check before signing an AMC

  1. Comprehensive or non-comprehensive. Are spares included?
  2. Exact scope. A written list of items and tasks, not "general maintenance".
  3. Visits. How many scheduled visits a year, and what each one checks.
  4. Response time. How quickly they attend an unscheduled call.
  5. Extra charges. Visit fees, materials, after-hours calls.
  6. Overlap with warranty. Nothing the warranty already covers should be in the price.
  7. Who does the work. The firm that built your interiors knows its own materials and fittings.
  8. Records. A visit report after each visit, which also helps if a warranty claim arises later.

If you skip the AMC: a simple maintenance calendar

How oftenWhat to do
Every few weeksWash chimney baffle filters; wipe and dry around sinks
Every 3 monthsCheck under-sink areas for leaks; tighten handles and hinges
Every 6 monthsService air-conditioners before summer and winter; check silicone joints
Every yearReseal granite counters; check door and window alignment; touch up paint

faqs.question: What is an AMC in interior design?
faqs.answer: An interior design AMC is an annual maintenance contract covering scheduled upkeep and minor repairs after a project is handed over, such as hinge and channel adjustment, sealant renewal, touch-ups and checks on electrical and plumbing points, for a fixed yearly fee.

faqs.question: Is an AMC the same as a warranty?
faqs.answer: No. A warranty covers defects in material or workmanship at no charge for a set period. An AMC is a paid contract for routine upkeep and wear. In the first year the two overlap most, so check the warranty before buying an AMC.

faqs.question: How much does an AMC cost for a home in India?
faqs.answer: There is no standard price for an interior AMC. As reference points, AC servicing contracts typically cost ₹2,000 to ₹6,000 per unit a year, and home lift AMCs ₹12,000 to ₹35,000 or more. Woodwork, electrical and plumbing upkeep is usually quoted per home.

faqs.question: What is the difference between a comprehensive and non-comprehensive AMC?
faqs.answer: A comprehensive AMC includes labour, visits and spare parts. A non-comprehensive AMC covers labour and visits only, with spares billed separately. Comprehensive costs more upfront but avoids surprise bills for parts.

faqs.question: Do I need an AMC in the first year after my interiors are done?
faqs.answer: Usually not. Most on-site work carries a warranty of around a year, and modular units and hardware often carry longer warranties. An AMC becomes more useful once those warranties end.

faqs.question: Who should do my interior maintenance?
faqs.answer: Ideally the firm that built your interiors, because it knows the materials, hardware and brands used. Whoever you choose, ask for a written scope, a visit schedule and a report after each visit.
